macros.name: MeetingSummary
macros.doc: The \MeetingSummary simply emits a unnumbered section title with a "Meeting Summary" title.

macros.name: Section
macros.doc: \Section{<title>} and \Subsection{<title>} respectively starts a numbered section and subsection with the given title.

macros.name: Section*
macros.doc: \Section{<title>} and \Subsection{<title>} respectively starts a numbered section and subsection with the given title.

macros.name: Signee
macros.doc: When giving the team member names in the mandatory {⟨members⟩} argument for the Meeting environment, you can indicate the members that should sign the entry using the \Signee command with the {⟨name⟩} argument.

macros.name: StartNotebook
macros.doc: Use this command to separate the front matter (cover pages and list of content) from your actual notebook entry.

macros.name: Subsection
macros.doc: \Section{<title>} and \Subsection{<title>} respectively starts a numbered section and subsection with the given title.

macros.name: Subsection*
macros.doc: \Section{<title>} and \Subsection{<title>} respectively starts a numbered section and subsection with the given title.

macros.name: TableEntryItemItem
macros.doc: The rows of tables with two columns are similarly entered with the \TableEntryTextText, \TableEntryTextItem, and \TableEntryItemItem commands. Each takes two mandatory arguments, one for each column.

macros.name: TableEntryTextItemItem
macros.doc: The rows of tables with three columns are entered by the \TableEntryTextTextText and \TableEntryTextItemItem commands. Each take three mandatory arguments to input the data for each of the three columns in a given row.

macros.name: TableEntryTextTextText
macros.doc: The rows of tables with three columns are entered by the \TableEntryTextTextText and \TableEntryTextItemItem commands. Each take three mandatory arguments to input the data for each of the three columns in a given row.

envs.name: Bio
envs.doc: The Bio environment creates a table in which the bio of each team member can be given.
